articles.title: National Geographic Society, Chubb Charitable Foundation Select First Three Freshwater Wetland Sites for New Blue Boundaries Program
articles.mainIdea: National Geographic Society, Chubb Charitable Foundation Select First Three Freshwater Wetland Sites for New Blue Boundaries Program
articles.summary: PR Newswire: National Geographic Society, Chubb Charitable Foundation Select First Three Freshwater Wetland Sites for New Blue Boundaries Program. Blue Boundaries, a partnership between the National Geographic Society and the Chubb Charitable Foundation, has selected its first focus locations across North America and Asia. Launched in 2025, the multiyear global initiative focuses on transformational change at the intersection of land and water.
